program tests
  implicit none
  integer :: n, d, i
  integer(8) :: x, b(100000,4) = 0_8, s(0:100000) = 0_8, t = 0_8, ans, r
  read(*,*) n, x
  do i = 1, n
    read(*,*) b(i,1:3)
    b(i,4) = b(i,1)*b(i,2)+(x-b(i,1))*b(i,3)
  end do
  call quick_sort(b(1:n,:),4)
  do i = 1, n
    s(i) = s(i-1)+b(i,4)
    t = t+b(i,1)*b(i,2)
  end do
  d = bisearch(n,s(0:n),t)
  if (d >= 0) then
    write(*,'(i0)') x*int(d,8)
    stop
  end if
  d = not(d)
  ans = x*int(n,8)
  do i = 1, d
    r = t-(s(d)-b(i,4))
    if (r <= 0_8) then
      ans = min(ans,x*int(d-1,8))
    else if (r <= b(i,1)*b(i,2)) then
      ans = min(ans,x*int(d-1,8)+(r+b(i,2)-1_8)/b(i,2))
    else
      r = r-b(i,1)*b(i,2)
      ans = min(ans,x*int(d-1,8)+b(i,1)+(r+b(i,3)-1_8)/b(i,3))
    end if
  end do
  do i = d+1, n
    r = t-s(d-1)
    if (r <= b(i,1)*b(i,2)) then
      ans = min(ans,x*int(d-1,8)+(r+b(i,2)-1_8)/b(i,2))
    else
      r = r-b(i,1)*b(i,2)
      ans = min(ans,x*int(d-1,8)+b(i,1)+(r+b(i,3)-1_8)/b(i,3))
    end if
  end do
  write(*,'(i0)') ans
  stop
contains
  function bisearch(n,a,x) result(r)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    integer(8), intent(in) :: a(0:n), x
    integer :: l, r, m
    r = not(n+1)
    if (x > a(n)) return
    r = n
    l = -1
    do while (r-l > 1)
      m = (l+r)/2
      if (x <= a(m)) then
        r = m
      else
        l = m
      end if
    end do
    if (a(r) /= x) r = not(r)
    return
  end function bisearch
  recursive subroutine quick_sort(a,i)
    implicit none
    integer(8), intent(inout) :: a(:,:)
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer(8) :: p, c(size(a(1,:)))
    integer :: n, l, r, m
    n = size(a(:,1))
    l = 1
    r = n
    m = (l+r)/2
    p = a(l,i)+a(m,i)+a(r,i)-max(a(l,i),a(m,i),a(r,i))-min(a(l,i),a(m,i),a(r,i))
    do
      do while (a(l,i) > p)
        l = l+1
      end do
      do while (a(r,i) < p)
        r = r-1
      end do
      if (l >= r) exit
      c = a(l,:)
      a(l,:) = a(r,:)
      a(r,:) = c
      l = l+1
      r = r-1
    end do
    if (l > 2) call quick_sort(a(1:l-1,:),i)
    if (n > r+1) call quick_sort(a(r+1:n,:),i)
    return
  end subroutine quick_sort
end program tests

main :: IO ()
main = do
  [n,x] <- map readInt . words <$> getLine
  blus <- VU.unfoldrN n (runStateT $ (,,) <$> rInt <*> rInt <*> rInt)
          <$> BSL.getContents
  print $ query n x blus

query :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector (Int,Int,Int) -> Int
query n x blus
  | totLoss <= 0 = 0
  | rest == 0 = retained * x
  | otherwise = (retained * x +)
    $ VU.minimum $ (`VU.map` VU.drop retained vblus)
    $ \(!v,!b,!l,!u) ->
      if v < rest then maxBound else min ((rest+l-1) `div` l)
                                         ((rest+(u-l)*b+u-1) `div` u)
  where
    vblus :: VU.Vector (Int,Int,Int,Int)
    vblus = VU.create $ do
      vec <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.map (\(b,l,u) -> (u*(x-b) + l*b,b,l,u)) blus
             :: ST s (VUM.MVector s (Int,Int,Int,Int))
      vam_sortBy (compare `on` (\(v,b,l,u) -> v)) vec
      return vec
    totLoss = VU.sum $ VU.map (\(v,b,l,u) -> b*l) vblus
    retained::Int
    rest::Int
    (retained,rest)
      = VU.ifoldr
        (\ !i (!v,!b,!l,!u) cont !rest ->
           case compare rest v of
             GT -> cont $! rest - v
             EQ -> (i+1,0)
             LT -> (i,rest)) undefined vblus totLoss

-- | Sorts an array using the default comparison.
vam_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vam_sort = vam_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vam_sort #-}

-- | sorts an array using a custom comparison.
vam_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vam_sortBy cmp vec
  | len <= 1  = return ()
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp vec 0
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp vec 0
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp vec 0
  | otherwise = do
      buf <- VGM.new len
      vam_mergeSortWithBuf cmp vec buf
 where
 len = VGM.length vec
{-# INLINE vam_sortBy #-}

vam_mergeSortWithBuf :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vam_mergeSortWithBuf cmp src buf = loop 0 (VGM.length src)
 where
   loop l u
     | len < vam_threshold = vai_sortByBounds cmp src l u
     | otherwise = do
         loop l mid
         loop mid u
         vam_merge cmp (VGM.unsafeSlice l len src) buf (mid - l)
           where len = u - l; mid = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vam_mergeSortWithBuf #-}

vam_merge :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
      => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> v (PrimState m) e
      -> Int -> m ()
vam_merge cmp src buf mid = do
  VGM.unsafeCopy tmp lower
  eTmp <- VGM.unsafeRead tmp 0
  eUpp <- VGM.unsafeRead upper 0
  loop tmp 0 eTmp upper 0 eUpp 0
 where
   lower = VGM.unsafeSlice 0   mid src
   upper = VGM.unsafeSlice mid (VGM.length src - mid) src
   tmp   = VGM.unsafeSlice 0   mid buf

   wroteHigh low iLow eLow high iHigh iIns
    | iHigh >= VGM.length high
      = VGM.unsafeCopy (VGM.unsafeSlice iIns (VGM.length low - iLow) src)
        (VGM.unsafeSlice iLow (VGM.length low - iLow) low)
    | otherwise = do
        eHigh <- VGM.unsafeRead high iHigh
        loop low iLow eLow high iHigh eHigh iIns

   wroteLow low iLow high iHigh eHigh iIns
    | iLow  >= VGM.length low  = return ()
    | otherwise = do
        eLow <- VGM.unsafeRead low iLow
        loop low iLow eLow high iHigh eHigh iIns

   loop !low !iLow !eLow !high !iHigh !eHigh !iIns = case cmp eHigh eLow of
     LT -> do VGM.unsafeWrite src iIns eHigh
              wroteHigh low iLow eLow high (iHigh + 1) (iIns + 1)
     _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite src iIns eLow
              wroteLow low (iLow + 1) high iHigh eHigh (iIns + 1)
{-# INLINE vam_merge #-}

vam_threshold :: Int
vam_threshold = 25
{-# INLINE vam_threshold #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default comparison for the type
vai_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vai_sort = vai_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vai_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a given comparison
vai_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vai_sortBy cmp a = vai_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vai_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of an array delimited by [l,u)
vai_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vai_sortByBounds cmp a l u
  | len < 2   = return ()
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
  | otherwise = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >>
                vai_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where
 len = u - l
{-# INLINE vai_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of the array delimited by [l,u) under the assumption
-- that [l,m) is already sorted.
vai_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vai_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vai_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vai_sortByBounds' #-}

-- Given a sorted array in [l,u), inserts val into its proper position,
-- yielding a sorted [l,u]
vai_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vai_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vai_insert #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the positions 'off' and 'off + 1' in the given
-- array using the comparison.
vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the two given indices using the comparison. This
-- is essentially a compare-and-swap, although the first index is assumed to
-- be the 'lower' of the two.
vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a i a1 >> VGM.unsafeWrite a j a0
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the three elements starting at the given offset in the array.
vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the three given indices. The indices are assumed
-- to be given from lowest to highest, so if 'l < m < u' then
-- 'vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a m l u' essentially sorts the median of three into the
-- lowest position in the array.
vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
            GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
                    LT -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a0
                    _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a1
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a j a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a0
            _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a1
                     VGM.unsafeWrite a j a0
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
            GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
                    GT -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a j a0
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a1
                    _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a j a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a1
            _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the four elements beginning at the offset.
vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

-- The horror...

-- | Sorts the elements at the four given indices. Like the 2 and 3 element

-- it can be used to sort medians into particular positions and so on.
vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()

  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k

    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of

                    GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of

                                             VGM.unsafeWrite a j a2

                                    _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a2

                                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a0
                                             VGM.unsafeWrite a l a3
                    _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of

                                            VGM.unsafeWrite a k a2
                                            VGM.unsafeWrite a l a0
                                   _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a1

-- | A type of comparisons between two values of a given type.
type Comparison e = e -> e -> Ordering

vac_copyOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vac_copyOffset from to iFrom iTo len =
  VGM.unsafeCopy (VGM.unsafeSlice iTo len to) (VGM.unsafeSlice iFrom len from)
{-# INLINE vac_copyOffset #-}

vac_inc :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v Int)
  => v (PrimState m) Int -> Int -> m Int
vac_inc arr i = VGM.unsafeRead arr i
  >>= \e -> VGM.unsafeWrite arr i (e+1) >> return e
{-# INLINE vac_inc #-}

-- shared bucket sorting stuff
vac_countLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => (e -> Int)
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
vac_countLoop rdx src count = VGM.set count 0 >> go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = VGM.unsafeRead src i >>= vac_inc count . rdx >> go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE vac_countLoop #-}

vac_midPoint :: Int -> Int -> Int
vac_midPoint a b =
  toInt $ (toWord a + toWord b) `div` 2
  where
    toWord :: Int -> Word
    toWord = fromIntegral

    toInt :: Word -> Int
    toInt = fromIntegral
{-# INLINE vac_midPoint #-}

main :: IO ()
main = do
  [n,x] <- map readInt . words <$> getLine
  blus <- VU.unfoldrN n (runStateT $ (,,) <$> rInt <*> rInt <*> rInt)
          <$> BSL.getContents
  print $ query n x blus

query :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector (Int,Int,Int) -> Int
query n x blus
  | totLoss <= 0 = 0
  | rest == 0 = retained * x
  | otherwise = (retained * x +)
    $ VU.minimum $ (`VU.map` VU.drop retained vblus)
    $ \(!v,!b,!l,!u) ->
      if v < rest then maxBound else min ((rest+l-1) `div` l)
                                         ((rest+(u-l)*b+u-1) `div` u)
  where
    vblus :: VU.Vector (Int,Int,Int,Int)
    vblus = VU.create $ do
      vec <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.map (\(b,l,u) -> (u*(x-b) + l*b,b,l,u)) blus
             :: ST s (VUM.MVector s (Int,Int,Int,Int))
      vam_sortBy (compare `on` (\(v,b,l,u) -> Down v)) vec
      return vec
    totLoss = VU.sum $ VU.map (\(v,b,l,u) -> b*l) vblus
    retained::Int
    rest::Int
    (retained,rest)
      = VU.ifoldr
        (\ !i (!v,!b,!l,!u) cont !rest ->
           case compare rest v of
             GT -> cont $! rest - v
             EQ -> (i+1,0)
             LT -> (i,rest)) undefined vblus totLoss

-- | Sorts an array using the default comparison.
vam_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vam_sort = vam_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vam_sort #-}

-- | sorts an array using a custom comparison.
vam_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vam_sortBy cmp vec
  | len <= 1  = return ()
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp vec 0
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp vec 0
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp vec 0
  | otherwise = do
      buf <- VGM.new len
      vam_mergeSortWithBuf cmp vec buf
 where
 len = VGM.length vec
{-# INLINE vam_sortBy #-}

vam_mergeSortWithBuf :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vam_mergeSortWithBuf cmp src buf = loop 0 (VGM.length src)
 where
   loop l u
     | len < vam_threshold = vai_sortByBounds cmp src l u
     | otherwise = do
         loop l mid
         loop mid u
         vam_merge cmp (VGM.unsafeSlice l len src) buf (mid - l)
           where len = u - l; mid = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vam_mergeSortWithBuf #-}

vam_merge :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
      => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> v (PrimState m) e
      -> Int -> m ()
vam_merge cmp src buf mid = do
  VGM.unsafeCopy tmp lower
  eTmp <- VGM.unsafeRead tmp 0
  eUpp <- VGM.unsafeRead upper 0
  loop tmp 0 eTmp upper 0 eUpp 0
 where
   lower = VGM.unsafeSlice 0   mid src
   upper = VGM.unsafeSlice mid (VGM.length src - mid) src
   tmp   = VGM.unsafeSlice 0   mid buf

   wroteHigh low iLow eLow high iHigh iIns
    | iHigh >= VGM.length high
      = VGM.unsafeCopy (VGM.unsafeSlice iIns (VGM.length low - iLow) src)
        (VGM.unsafeSlice iLow (VGM.length low - iLow) low)
    | otherwise = do
        eHigh <- VGM.unsafeRead high iHigh
        loop low iLow eLow high iHigh eHigh iIns

   wroteLow low iLow high iHigh eHigh iIns
    | iLow  >= VGM.length low  = return ()
    | otherwise = do
        eLow <- VGM.unsafeRead low iLow
        loop low iLow eLow high iHigh eHigh iIns

   loop !low !iLow !eLow !high !iHigh !eHigh !iIns = case cmp eHigh eLow of
     LT -> do VGM.unsafeWrite src iIns eHigh
              wroteHigh low iLow eLow high (iHigh + 1) (iIns + 1)
     _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite src iIns eLow
              wroteLow low (iLow + 1) high iHigh eHigh (iIns + 1)
{-# INLINE vam_merge #-}

vam_threshold :: Int
vam_threshold = 25
{-# INLINE vam_threshold #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default comparison for the type
vai_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vai_sort = vai_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vai_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a given comparison
vai_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vai_sortBy cmp a = vai_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vai_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of an array delimited by [l,u)
vai_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vai_sortByBounds cmp a l u
  | len < 2   = return ()
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
  | otherwise = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >>
                vai_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where
 len = u - l
{-# INLINE vai_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of the array delimited by [l,u) under the assumption
-- that [l,m) is already sorted.
vai_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vai_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vai_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vai_sortByBounds' #-}

-- Given a sorted array in [l,u), inserts val into its proper position,
-- yielding a sorted [l,u]
vai_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vai_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vai_insert #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the positions 'off' and 'off + 1' in the given
-- array using the comparison.
vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the two given indices using the comparison. This
-- is essentially a compare-and-swap, although the first index is assumed to
-- be the 'lower' of the two.
vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a i a1 >> VGM.unsafeWrite a j a0
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the three elements starting at the given offset in the array.
vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the three given indices. The indices are assumed
-- to be given from lowest to highest, so if 'l < m < u' then
-- 'vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a m l u' essentially sorts the median of three into the
-- lowest position in the array.
vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
            GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
                    LT -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a0
                    _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a1
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a j a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a0
            _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a1
                     VGM.unsafeWrite a j a0
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
            GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
                    GT -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a j a0
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a1
                    _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a j a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a1
            _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the four elements beginning at the offset.
vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()

  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i

  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k

    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of

                                    _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a2
                                             VGM.unsafeWrite a j a1
                                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a0
                                             VGM.unsafeWrite a l a3
                    _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
                           GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of

vac_copyOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vac_copyOffset from to iFrom iTo len =
  VGM.unsafeCopy (VGM.unsafeSlice iTo len to) (VGM.unsafeSlice iFrom len from)
{-# INLINE vac_copyOffset #-}

vac_inc :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v Int)
  => v (PrimState m) Int -> Int -> m Int
vac_inc arr i = VGM.unsafeRead arr i
  >>= \e -> VGM.unsafeWrite arr i (e+1) >> return e
{-# INLINE vac_inc #-}

-- shared bucket sorting stuff
vac_countLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => (e -> Int)
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
vac_countLoop rdx src count = VGM.set count 0 >> go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = VGM.unsafeRead src i >>= vac_inc count . rdx >> go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE vac_countLoop #-}

vac_midPoint :: Int -> Int -> Int
vac_midPoint a b =
  toInt $ (toWord a + toWord b) `div` 2
  where
    toWord :: Int -> Word
    toWord = fromIntegral

    toInt :: Word -> Int
    toInt = fromIntegral
{-# INLINE vac_midPoint #-}

main :: IO ()
main = do
  [n,x] <- map readInt . words <$> getLine
  blus <- VU.unfoldrN n (runStateT $ (,,) <$> rInt <*> rInt <*> rInt)
          <$> BSL.getContents
  print $ query n x blus

query :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector (Int,Int,Int) -> Int
query n x blus
  | totLoss <= 0 = 0
  | rest == 0 = retained * x
  | otherwise = (retained * x +)
    $ VU.minimum $ (`VU.imap` VU.takeWhile (\(v,b,l,u) -> v>=rest) vblus)
    $ \i (!v,!b,!l,!u) ->
      if | i < retained -> let trueRest = rest + v - vret
                           in min ((trueRest + l-1) `div` l)
                                  ((trueRest + (u-l)*b + u-1) `div` u)
         | otherwise -> min ((rest + l-1) `div` l)
                            ((rest + (u-l)*b + u-1) `div` u)
  where
    vblus :: VU.Vector (Int,Int,Int,Int)
    vblus = VU.create $ do
      vec <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.map (\(b,l,u) -> (u*(x-b) + l*b,b,l,u)) blus
             :: ST s (VUM.MVector s (Int,Int,Int,Int))
      vam_sortBy (compare `on` (\(v,b,l,u) -> Down v)) vec
      return vec
    totLoss = VU.sum $ VU.map (\(v,b,l,u) -> b*l) vblus
    retained::Int
    rest::Int
    (vret,_,_,_) = vblus VU.! retained
    (retained,rest)
      = VU.ifoldr
        (\ !i (!v,!b,!l,!u) cont !rest ->
           case compare rest v of
             GT -> cont $! rest - v
             EQ -> (i+1,0)
             LT -> (i,rest)) undefined vblus totLoss

-- | Sorts an array using the default comparison.
vam_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vam_sort = vam_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vam_sort #-}

-- | sorts an array using a custom comparison.
vam_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vam_sortBy cmp vec
  | len <= 1  = return ()
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp vec 0
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp vec 0
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp vec 0
  | otherwise = do
      buf <- VGM.new len
      vam_mergeSortWithBuf cmp vec buf
 where
 len = VGM.length vec
{-# INLINE vam_sortBy #-}

vam_mergeSortWithBuf :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vam_mergeSortWithBuf cmp src buf = loop 0 (VGM.length src)
 where
   loop l u
     | len < vam_threshold = vai_sortByBounds cmp src l u
     | otherwise = do
         loop l mid
         loop mid u
         vam_merge cmp (VGM.unsafeSlice l len src) buf (mid - l)
           where len = u - l; mid = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vam_mergeSortWithBuf #-}

vam_merge :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
      => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> v (PrimState m) e
      -> Int -> m ()
vam_merge cmp src buf mid = do
  VGM.unsafeCopy tmp lower
  eTmp <- VGM.unsafeRead tmp 0
  eUpp <- VGM.unsafeRead upper 0
  loop tmp 0 eTmp upper 0 eUpp 0
 where
   lower = VGM.unsafeSlice 0   mid src
   upper = VGM.unsafeSlice mid (VGM.length src - mid) src
   tmp   = VGM.unsafeSlice 0   mid buf

   wroteHigh low iLow eLow high iHigh iIns
    | iHigh >= VGM.length high
      = VGM.unsafeCopy (VGM.unsafeSlice iIns (VGM.length low - iLow) src)
        (VGM.unsafeSlice iLow (VGM.length low - iLow) low)
    | otherwise = do
        eHigh <- VGM.unsafeRead high iHigh
        loop low iLow eLow high iHigh eHigh iIns

   wroteLow low iLow high iHigh eHigh iIns
    | iLow  >= VGM.length low  = return ()
    | otherwise = do
        eLow <- VGM.unsafeRead low iLow
        loop low iLow eLow high iHigh eHigh iIns

   loop !low !iLow !eLow !high !iHigh !eHigh !iIns = case cmp eHigh eLow of
     LT -> do VGM.unsafeWrite src iIns eHigh
              wroteHigh low iLow eLow high (iHigh + 1) (iIns + 1)
     _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite src iIns eLow
              wroteLow low (iLow + 1) high iHigh eHigh (iIns + 1)
{-# INLINE vam_merge #-}

vam_threshold :: Int
vam_threshold = 25
{-# INLINE vam_threshold #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default comparison for the type
vai_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vai_sort = vai_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vai_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a given comparison
vai_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vai_sortBy cmp a = vai_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vai_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of an array delimited by [l,u)
vai_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vai_sortByBounds cmp a l u
  | len < 2   = return ()
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
  | otherwise = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >>
                vai_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where
 len = u - l
{-# INLINE vai_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of the array delimited by [l,u) under the assumption
-- that [l,m) is already sorted.
vai_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vai_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vai_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vai_sortByBounds' #-}

-- Given a sorted array in [l,u), inserts val into its proper position,
-- yielding a sorted [l,u]
vai_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vai_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vai_insert #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the positions 'off' and 'off + 1' in the given
-- array using the comparison.
vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the two given indices using the comparison. This
-- is essentially a compare-and-swap, although the first index is assumed to
-- be the 'lower' of the two.
vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a i a1 >> VGM.unsafeWrite a j a0
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the three elements starting at the given offset in the array.
vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the three given indices. The indices are assumed
-- to be given from lowest to highest, so if 'l < m < u' then
-- 'vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a m l u' essentially sorts the median of three into the
-- lowest position in the array.
vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
            GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
                    LT -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a0
                    _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a1
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a j a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a0
            _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a1
                     VGM.unsafeWrite a j a0
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
            GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
                    GT -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a j a0
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a1
                    _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a j a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a1
            _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the four elements beginning at the offset.
vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vac_copyOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vac_copyOffset from to iFrom iTo len =
  VGM.unsafeCopy (VGM.unsafeSlice iTo len to) (VGM.unsafeSlice iFrom len from)
{-# INLINE vac_copyOffset #-}

vac_inc :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v Int)
  => v (PrimState m) Int -> Int -> m Int
vac_inc arr i = VGM.unsafeRead arr i
  >>= \e -> VGM.unsafeWrite arr i (e+1) >> return e
{-# INLINE vac_inc #-}

-- shared bucket sorting stuff
vac_countLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => (e -> Int)
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
vac_countLoop rdx src count = VGM.set count 0 >> go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = VGM.unsafeRead src i >>= vac_inc count . rdx >> go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE vac_countLoop #-}

vac_midPoint :: Int -> Int -> Int
vac_midPoint a b =
  toInt $ (toWord a + toWord b) `div` 2
  where
    toWord :: Int -> Word
    toWord = fromIntegral

    toInt :: Word -> Int
    toInt = fromIntegral
{-# INLINE vac_midPoint #-}

main :: IO ()
main = do
  [n,x] <- map readInt . words <$> getLine
  blus <- VU.unfoldrN n (runStateT $ (,,) <$> rInt <*> rInt <*> rInt)
          <$> BSL.getContents
  print $ query n x blus

query :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector (Int,Int,Int) -> Int
query n x blus
  | totLoss <= 0 = 0
  | rest == 0 = retained * x
  | otherwise = (retained * x +)
    $ VU.minimum $ (`VU.map` VU.drop retained vblus)
    $ \(!v,!b,!l,!u) ->
      if v < rest then maxBound else min ((rest+l-1) `div` l)
                                         ((rest+(u-l)*b+u-1) `div` u)
  where
    vblus :: VU.Vector (Int,Int,Int,Int)
    vblus = VU.create $ do
      vec <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.map (\(b,l,u) -> (u*(x-b) + l*b,b,l,u)) blus
             :: ST s (VUM.MVector s (Int,Int,Int,Int))
      vam_sortBy (compare `on` (\(v,b,l,u) -> Down v)) vec
      return vec
    totLoss = VU.sum $ VU.map (\(v,b,l,u) -> b*l) vblus
    retained::Int
    rest::Int
    (retained,rest)
      = VU.ifoldr
        (\ !i (!v,!b,!l,!u) cont !rest ->
           case compare rest v of
             GT -> cont $! rest - v
             EQ -> (i+1,0)
             LT -> (i,rest)) undefined vblus totLoss

-- | Sorts an array using the default comparison.
vam_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vam_sort = vam_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vam_sort #-}

-- | sorts an array using a custom comparison.
vam_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vam_sortBy cmp vec
  | len <= 1  = return ()
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp vec 0
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp vec 0
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp vec 0
  | otherwise = do
      buf <- VGM.new len
      vam_mergeSortWithBuf cmp vec buf
 where
 len = VGM.length vec
{-# INLINE vam_sortBy #-}

vam_mergeSortWithBuf :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vam_mergeSortWithBuf cmp src buf = loop 0 (VGM.length src)
 where
   loop l u
     | len < vam_threshold = vai_sortByBounds cmp src l u
     | otherwise = do
         loop l mid
         loop mid u
         vam_merge cmp (VGM.unsafeSlice l len src) buf (mid - l)
           where len = u - l; mid = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vam_mergeSortWithBuf #-}

vam_merge :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
      => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> v (PrimState m) e
      -> Int -> m ()
vam_merge cmp src buf mid = do
  VGM.unsafeCopy tmp lower
  eTmp <- VGM.unsafeRead tmp 0
  eUpp <- VGM.unsafeRead upper 0
  loop tmp 0 eTmp upper 0 eUpp 0
 where
   lower = VGM.unsafeSlice 0   mid src
   upper = VGM.unsafeSlice mid (VGM.length src - mid) src
   tmp   = VGM.unsafeSlice 0   mid buf

   wroteHigh low iLow eLow high iHigh iIns
    | iHigh >= VGM.length high
      = VGM.unsafeCopy (VGM.unsafeSlice iIns (VGM.length low - iLow) src)
        (VGM.unsafeSlice iLow (VGM.length low - iLow) low)
    | otherwise = do
        eHigh <- VGM.unsafeRead high iHigh
        loop low iLow eLow high iHigh eHigh iIns

   wroteLow low iLow high iHigh eHigh iIns
    | iLow  >= VGM.length low  = return ()
    | otherwise = do
        eLow <- VGM.unsafeRead low iLow
        loop low iLow eLow high iHigh eHigh iIns

   loop !low !iLow !eLow !high !iHigh !eHigh !iIns = case cmp eHigh eLow of
     LT -> do VGM.unsafeWrite src iIns eHigh
              wroteHigh low iLow eLow high (iHigh + 1) (iIns + 1)
     _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite src iIns eLow
              wroteLow low (iLow + 1) high iHigh eHigh (iIns + 1)
{-# INLINE vam_merge #-}

vam_threshold :: Int
vam_threshold = 25
{-# INLINE vam_threshold #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default comparison for the type
vai_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vai_sort = vai_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vai_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a given comparison
vai_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vai_sortBy cmp a = vai_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vai_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of an array delimited by [l,u)
vai_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vai_sortByBounds cmp a l u
  | len < 2   = return ()
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
  | otherwise = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >>
                vai_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where
 len = u - l
{-# INLINE vai_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of the array delimited by [l,u) under the assumption
-- that [l,m) is already sorted.
vai_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vai_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vai_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vai_sortByBounds' #-}

-- Given a sorted array in [l,u), inserts val into its proper position,
-- yielding a sorted [l,u]
vai_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vai_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vai_insert #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the positions 'off' and 'off + 1' in the given
-- array using the comparison.
vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the two given indices using the comparison. This
-- is essentially a compare-and-swap, although the first index is assumed to
-- be the 'lower' of the two.
vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a i a1 >> VGM.unsafeWrite a j a0
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the three elements starting at the given offset in the array.
vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the three given indices. The indices are assumed
-- to be given from lowest to highest, so if 'l < m < u' then
-- 'vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a m l u' essentially sorts the median of three into the
-- lowest position in the array.
vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
            GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
                    LT -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a0
                    _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a1
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a j a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a0
            _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a1
                     VGM.unsafeWrite a j a0
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
            GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
                    GT -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a i a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a j a0
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a1
                    _  -> do VGM.unsafeWrite a j a2
                             VGM.unsafeWrite a k a1
            _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the four elements beginning at the offset.
vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

def solve_agc034c():
    from bisect import bisect_left
    from collections import namedtuple
    from functools import lru_cache
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.readline

    Test = namedtuple('Test', 'Aoki_score lower_bound upper_bound')

    Test.Merit = lambda self, Takahashi_score: \
        self.lower_bound * Takahashi_score if Takahashi_score <= self.Aoki_score \
            else self.upper_bound * Takahashi_score - (self.upper_bound - self.lower_bound) * self.Aoki_score
    # Test.Merit = lru_cache(maxsize=None)(Test.Merit)

    N, X = map(int, input().split())
    tests = []
    for _ in range(N):
        row = map(int, input().split())
        tests.append(Test(*row))
    tests.sort(key=lambda test: test.Merit(Takahashi_score=X), reverse=True)
    # 勝つ科目は重要度upper_bound,負ける科目は重要度lower_bound

    need = sum(test.lower_bound * test.Aoki_score for test in tests)

    *acc, = accumulate(test.Merit(Takahashi_score=X) for test in tests)

    bi = bisect_left(acc, need)  # bi問目まで完答でneed以上を達成(bi:1-indexed)=bi問解けばよい
    ge_need = acc[bi]  # need以上を達成するのに要した点数
    lt_need = acc[bi - 1]  # need未満の最大値を達成するのに要した点数

    def generate_candidates():
        INF = 10 ** 20
        for i, p in enumerate(tests, start=1):
            # p: partially_solved_test
            if i < bi:
                rest = need - (ge_need - p.Merit(Takahashi_score=X))
            else:
                rest = need - lt_need

            if rest <= p.Merit(Takahashi_score=p.Aoki_score):
                # 科目p単体の所要点数はAoki君以下でよく,lower_boundで計算
                add_ = (rest + p.lower_bound - 1) // p.lower_bound
            else:
                # 科目p単体の所要点数はAoki君を超える必要があり,upper_boundで計算
                add_ = p.Aoki_score
                add_ += (rest - p.Merit(Takahashi_score=p.Aoki_score) + p.upper_bound - 1) // p.upper_bound

            if add_ > X:
                yield INF
            else:
                ret = X * (bi - 1) + add_
                yield ret

    gen = generate_candidates()
    res = min(gen)
    print(res)
    return

def solve(N: int, X: int, b: "List[int]", l: "List[int]", u: "List[int]"):

    # i番目のテストで高橋くんがx点とったとき、A-Bに加える量
    def f(i, x):
        if x <= b[i]:
            return l[i]*(x-b[i])
        else:
            return u[i]*(x-b[i])

    # あらかじめ、0点とった時とX点とった時の効果が大きい順に並べておく
    mh = [[f(i, X)-f(i, 0), i] for i in range(N)]
    mh.sort(reverse=True)
    mXacc = list(accumulate([f(i, X) for _, i in mh]))
    m0acc = list(accumulate([f(i, 0) for _, i in mh]))
    # print(mh)
    # print(mX)
    # print(mXacc)
    # print(m0)
    # print(m0acc)

    def isOK(index, key):
        # 勉強時間Tとしてスコア(A-B)を最大化するよう勉強時間を配分する
        T = index
        num = 1+T//X          # 点をとるテストの個数
        # print(num)
        # いったんX点とらせる
        # D = sum([f(i, X) for _, i in mh[:num]])\
        #     + sum([f(i, 0) for _, i in mh[num:]])
        # print(D)
        # print("A", mXacc[num-1])
        # print("B", m0acc[-1]-m0acc[num-1])
        D = mXacc[num-1] + m0acc[-1]-m0acc[num-1]
        # print(D)
        # 点を取るテストの中で、点数をT%X点に変更した時、
        # 最も減少の小さいものを選ぶ
        a = [0]*N
        for _, j in mh[:num]:
            a[j] = X
        v, i = min([[f(i, X)-f(i, T % X), i] for _, i in mh[:num]])
        D -= v
        a[i] = T % X
        # print(D)
        # print(a)
        return D >= key

    def binary_search(key):
        ng = -1
        ok = N*X
        while abs(ok - ng) > 1:
            mid = (ok + ng)//2
            # print("ng, mid, ok = {}, {}, {}".format(ng, mid, ok))
            if isOK(mid, key):
                ok = mid
            else:
                ng = mid
        return ok

    ans = binary_search(0)

    return

def factorize(n):
    """return the factors of the Arg and count of each factor
    
    Args:
        n (long): number to be resolved into factors
    
    Returns:
        list of tuples: factorize(220) returns [(2, 2), (5, 1), (11, 1)]
    """
    fct = []  # prime factor
    b, e = 2, 0  # base, exponent
    while b * b <= n:
        while n % b == 0:
            n = n // b
            e = e + 1
        if e > 0:
            fct.append((b, e))
        b, e = b + 1, 0
    if n > 1:
        fct.append((n, 1))
    return fct
def combinations_count(n, r):
    """Return the number of selecting r pieces of items from n kinds of items.
    
    Args:
        n (long): number
        r (long): number
    
    Raises:
        Exception: not defined when n or r is negative
    
    Returns:
        long: number
    """
    # TODO: How should I do when n - r is negative?
    if n < 0 or r < 0:
        raise Exception('combinations_count(n, r) not defined when n or r is negative')
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r < 0: return 0
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n
    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    for p in range(2,r+1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p-1,r,p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot
    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])
    return result
def combinations_with_replacement_count(n, r):
    """Return the number of selecting r pieces of items from n kinds of items allowing individual elements to be repeated more than once.
    
    Args:
        n (long): number
        r (long): number
    
    Raises:
        Exception: not defined when n or r is negative
    
    Returns:
        long: number
    """
    if n < 0 or r < 0:
        raise Exception('combinations_with_replacement_count(n, r) not defined when n or r is negative')
    elif n == 0:
        return 1
    else:
        return combinations_count(n + r - 1, r)

def chmin(x, y):
    """change minimum
    if x > y, x = y and return (x, True).
    convenient when solving problems of dp[i]
    
    Args:
        x (long): current minimum value
        y (long): potential minimum value
    
    Returns:
        (x, bool): (x, True) when updated, else (x, False)
    """
    if x > y:
        x = y
        return (x, True)
    else:
        return (x, False)
def chmax(x, y):
    """change maximum
    if x < y, x = y and return (x, True).
    convenient when solving problems of dp[i]
    
    Args:
        x (long): current maximum value
        y (long): potential maximum value
    
    Returns:
        (x, bool): (x, True) when updated, else (x, False)
    """
    if x < y:
        x = y
        return (x, True)
    else:
        return (x, False)

def modinv_list(n, p = MOD):
    if n <= 1:
        return [0,1][:n+1]
    else:
        inv_t = [0,1]
        for i in range(2, n+1):
            inv_t += [inv_t[p % i] * (p - int(p / i)) % p]
        return inv_t
def modfactorial_list(n, p = MOD):
    if n == 0:
        return [1]
    else:
        l = [0] * (n+1)
        tmp = 1
        for i in range(1, n+1):
            tmp = tmp * i % p
            l[i] = tmp
        return l
def modcomb(n, k, fac_list = [], p = MOD):
    # fac_list = modfactorial_list(100)
    # print(modcomb(100, 5, modfactorial_list(100)))
    from math import factorial
    if n < 0 or k < 0 or n < k: return 0
    if n == 0 or k == 0: return 1
    if len(fac_list) <= n:
        a = factorial(n) % p
        b = factorial(k) % p
        c = factorial(n-k) % p
    else:
        a = fac_list[n]
        b = fac_list[k]
        c = fac_list[n-k]
    return (a * modpow(b, p-2, p) * modpow(c, p-2, p)) % p

def gcd(a, b):
    a, b = max(a, b), min(a, b)
    while a % b > 0: a, b = b, a % b
    return b
  
def solve():
    file = sys.stdin.readline
    N, X = map(int, file().split())
    aoki = [None] * N
    for i in range(N):
        b, l, u = map(int, file().split())
        aoki[i] = [u,  l, -b]
    aoki.sort()
    low = [0] * (N + 1)
    high = [0] * (N + 1)
    takahashi = [0] * (N + 1)
    for i in range(N):
        low[i+1] = low[i] + aoki[i][2] *  (-1) * aoki[i][1]
        high[i+1] = high[i] + aoki[i][0]  * (-1) * aoki[i][2]
        takahashi[i+1] = takahashi[i] + aoki[i][0] * X

    minhour = X * N
    tmult = 1
    for i in range(1, N):
        S = low[i] + high[N] - high[i]
        tpoint = takahashi[N] - takahashi[i]

            if math.ceil((S -tpoint) / tmult) > X: break
            else: extra = math.ceil((S - tpoint) / tmult)
            minhour = min(minhour, X * (N - i) + extra)
    print(minhour)

    return 0

def bisect_right_callable(fn, x, lo, hi):
    """
    lo から hi-1 のうち、fn の結果が x 以下となる、最も右の値 + 1
    bisect.bisect_right と同じ
    https://docs.python.org/ja/3/library/bisect.html
    :param callable fn:
    :param x:
    :param int lo: 最小値
    :param int hi: 最大値 + 1
    :return: lo <= ret <= hi
    """
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if x < fn(mid):
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid + 1
    return lo

def solve_agc034c():
    from bisect import bisect_left
    from collections import namedtuple
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    # input = TestCaseReader()

    Test = namedtuple('Test', 'Aoki_score lower_bound upper_bound')
    Test.Merit = lambda self, Takahashi_score: \
        self.lower_bound * Takahashi_score if Takahashi_score <= self.Aoki_score \
            else self.upper_bound * Takahashi_score - (self.upper_bound - self.lower_bound) * self.Aoki_score

    N, X = map(int, input().split())
    tests = []
    for _ in range(N):
        row = map(int, input().split())
        tests.append(Test(*row))
    tests.sort(key=lambda test: test.Merit(Takahashi_score=X), reverse=True)
    # 勝つ科目は重要度upper_bound,負ける科目は重要度lower_bound

    need = sum(test.lower_bound * test.Aoki_score for test in tests)

    *acc, = accumulate(test.Merit(Takahashi_score=X) for test in tests)

    bi = bisect_left(acc, need)  # bi問目まで完答でneed以上を達成(bi:1-indexed)=bi問解けばよい
    if bi == 0:
        print(0)  # 追加した
        return

    ge_need = acc[bi]  # need以上を達成するのに要した点数
    lt_need = acc[bi - 1]  # need未満の最大値を達成するのに要した点数

    def generate_candidates():
        INF = 10 ** 20
        for i, p in enumerate(tests, start=1):
            # p: partially_solved_test
            if i < bi:
                rest = need - (ge_need - p.Merit(Takahashi_score=X))
            else:
                rest = need - lt_need

            if rest <= p.Merit(Takahashi_score=p.Aoki_score):
                # 科目p単体の所要点数はAoki君以下でよく,lower_boundで計算
                add_ = (rest + p.lower_bound - 1) // p.lower_bound
            else:
                # 科目p単体の所要点数はAoki君を超える必要があり,upper_boundで計算
                add_ = p.Aoki_score
                add_ += (rest - p.Merit(Takahashi_score=p.Aoki_score) + p.upper_bound - 1) // p.upper_bound

            if add_ > X:
                yield INF
            else:
                ret = X * (bi - 1) + add_
                yield ret

    gen = generate_candidates()
    res = min(gen)
    print(res)
    return

    solve_agc034c()

def combinations_count(n, r):
    # faster than the following code
    # def combinations_count(n, r):
    #     return factorial(n) // (factorial(n - r) * factorial(r))
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n
    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    for p in range(2,r+1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p-1,r,p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot
    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])
    return result
def combination_with_repetition_count(n, r):
    return combinations_count(n + r - 1, r)

from itertools import accumulate
import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline

def solve(N, X, BLUs):
    vs = [(L*B + U*(X-B), i) for i, (B, L, U) in enumerate(BLUs)]
    vs.sort(reverse=True)

    accVs = list(accumulate([0] + vs, lambda accX, X: accX + X[0]))
    D0 = -sum([L*B for B, L, U in BLUs])

    def isOK(k):
        q = k // X
        r = k % X
        accV1, accV = accVs[q+1], accVs[q]
        for odr, (v, i) in enumerate(vs):
            B, L, U = BLUs[i]
            d = D0
            if odr < q:
                d += accV1 - v
            else:
                d += accV
            if r <= B:
                d += L*r
            else:
                d += L*B + U*(r-B)
            if d >= 0:
                return True
        return False

    ng, ok = -1, N*X
    while abs(ok-ng) > 1:
        mid = (ng+ok) // 2
        if isOK(mid):
            ok = mid
        else:
            ng = mid

    return ok

from itertools import accumulate

def main():
    N,X=map(int,input().split())
    A=[list(map(int,input().split())) for i in range(N)]

    A.sort(key=lambda x:x[2]*(X-x[0])+x[0]*x[1],reverse=True)
    ALL=[a[2]*(X-a[0])+a[0]*a[1] for a in A]



    SUM=[0]+list(accumulate(ALL))

    MAX=0
    MINUS=0

    for a,r,l in A:
        MAX+=a
        MINUS+=a*r

    OUT=-1

    def binsearch(score):

        alluse=score//X
        rest=score-alluse*X

        for ri in range(N):
            plus=0
            b,l,u=A[ri]
            
            if rest<b:
                plus+=rest*l
            else:
                plus+=rest*u+b*l-b*u

            if alluse<=ri:
                plus+=SUM[alluse]

            else:
                plus+=SUM[alluse+1]-ALL[ri]

            #print(score,ri,plus)

            if plus>=MINUS:
                return 1

        return 0


    while MAX-OUT>1:
        mid=(MAX+OUT)//2

        if binsearch(mid)==1:
            MAX=mid
        else:
            OUT=mid

    print(MAX)

def accumulate(a):
    su = 0
    yield su

    for x in a:
        su += x
        yield su


def solve_agc034c():
    from collections import namedtuple
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.readline

    Test = namedtuple('Test', 'Aoki_score lower_bound upper_bound')
    Test.D_partial = lambda self, score: \
        self.lower_bound * score if score <= self.Aoki_score \
            else self.upper_bound * score - (self.upper_bound - self.lower_bound) * self.Aoki_score

    def is_ok(init_rest):
        """init_rest: 勉強に使える時間"""
        take, rest = divmod(init_rest, X)
        if take > N - 1:
            r = take - (N - 1)
            take = N - 1
            rest += r * X

        for i, partial_solve_test in enumerate(tests, start=1):
            when_full = partial_solve_test.D_partial(X)
            if i <= take:
                su = acc[take + 1] - when_full
            else:
                su = acc[take]

            when_partial = partial_solve_test.D_partial(min(X, rest))
            d = INIT_D + su + when_partial
            if d >= 0:
                return True

        return False

    def binary_search(*, ok, ng, is_ok):
        while abs(ok - ng) > 1:
            mid = (ok + ng) // 2
            if is_ok(mid):
                ok = mid
            else:
                ng = mid
        return ok

    N, X = map(int, input().split())
    tests = []
    for _ in range(N):
        row = map(int, input().split())
        tests.append(Test(*row))
    tests.sort(key=lambda test: test.D_partial(X), reverse=True)
    # 勝つ科目と負ける科目を決める
    # 勝つ科目は重要度をupper_boundにする
    # 負ける科目は重要度をlower_boundにする

    INIT_D = -sum(test.lower_bound * test.Aoki_score for test in tests)

    *acc, = accumulate(test.D_partial(X) for test in tests)

    res = binary_search(ok=10 ** 10, ng=-1, is_ok=is_ok)
    # D>=0となる勉強時間

    print(res)
    return

    solve_agc034c()

def factorize(n):
    """return the factors of the Arg and count of each factor
    
    Args:
        n (long): number to be resolved into factors
    
    Returns:
        list of tuples: factorize(220) returns [(2, 2), (5, 1), (11, 1)]
    """
    fct = []  # prime factor
    b, e = 2, 0  # base, exponent
    while b * b <= n:
        while n % b == 0:
            n = n // b
            e = e + 1
        if e > 0:
            fct.append((b, e))
        b, e = b + 1, 0
    if n > 1:
        fct.append((n, 1))
    return fct
def combinations_count(n, r):
    """Return the number of selecting r pieces of items from n kinds of items.
    
    Args:
        n (long): number
        r (long): number
    
    Raises:
        Exception: not defined when n or r is negative
    
    Returns:
        long: number
    """
    # TODO: How should I do when n - r is negative?
    if n < 0 or r < 0:
        raise Exception('combinations_count(n, r) not defined when n or r is negative')
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r < 0: return 0
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n
    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    for p in range(2,r+1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p-1,r,p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot
    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])
    return result
def combinations_with_replacement_count(n, r):
    """Return the number of selecting r pieces of items from n kinds of items allowing individual elements to be repeated more than once.
    
    Args:
        n (long): number
        r (long): number
    
    Raises:
        Exception: not defined when n or r is negative
    
    Returns:
        long: number
    """
    if n < 0 or r < 0:
        raise Exception('combinations_with_replacement_count(n, r) not defined when n or r is negative')
    elif n == 0:
        return 1
    else:
        return combinations_count(n + r - 1, r)

def main():
  n, x = map(int, input().split())
  BLU = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
  B, L, U = zip(*BLU)
  S = [b*l+(x-b)*u for b, l, u in BLU]
  sortedS = sorted([(s, i) for i, s in enumerate(S)], reverse=True)
  S, idx = zip(*sortedS)
  B = [B[i] for i in idx]
  L = [L[i] for i in idx]
  U = [U[i] for i in idx]
  M = sum([b*l for b, l, u in BLU])

  def select(q, r):
    f = sum(S[:q+1])
    for i in range(n):
      temp = f - S[min(i, q)]
      temp += L[i]*min(B[i], r) + U[i]*max(r-B[i], 0)
      if temp>=M:
        return True
    return False

  ng = -1
  ok = sum(B)
  while ok-ng > 1:
    mid = (ok+ng)//2
    q, r = divmod(mid, x)
    if select(q, r):
      ok = mid
    else:
      ng = mid
  print(ok)
  
if __name__ == "__main__":
  main()

def factorize(n):
    """return the factors of the Arg and count of each factor
    
    Args:
        n (long): number to be resolved into factors
    
    Returns:
        list of tuples: factorize(220) returns [(2, 2), (5, 1), (11, 1)]
    """
    fct = []  # prime factor
    b, e = 2, 0  # base, exponent
    while b * b <= n:
        while n % b == 0:
            n = n // b
            e = e + 1
        if e > 0:
            fct.append((b, e))
        b, e = b + 1, 0
    if n > 1:
        fct.append((n, 1))
    return fct
def combinations_count(n, r):
    """Return the number of selecting r pieces of items from n kinds of items.
    
    Args:
        n (long): number
        r (long): number
    
    Raises:
        Exception: not defined when n or r is negative
    
    Returns:
        long: number
    """
    # TODO: How should I do when n - r is negative?
    if n < 0 or r < 0:
        raise Exception('combinations_count(n, r) not defined when n or r is negative')
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r < 0: return 0
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n
    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    for p in range(2,r+1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p-1,r,p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot
    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])
    return result
def combinations_with_replacement_count(n, r):
    """Return the number of selecting r pieces of items from n kinds of items allowing individual elements to be repeated more than once.
    
    Args:
        n (long): number
        r (long): number
    
    Raises:
        Exception: not defined when n or r is negative
    
    Returns:
        long: number
    """
    if n < 0 or r < 0:
        raise Exception('combinations_with_replacement_count(n, r) not defined when n or r is negative')
    elif n == 0:
        return 1
    else:
        return combinations_count(n + r - 1, r)

def chmin(x, y):
    """change minimum
    if x > y, x = y and return (x, True).
    convenient when solving problems of dp[i]
    
    Args:
        x (long): current minimum value
        y (long): potential minimum value
    
    Returns:
        (x, bool): (x, True) when updated, else (x, False)
    """
    if x > y:
        x = y
        return (x, True)
    else:
        return (x, False)
def chmax(x, y):
    """change maximum
    if x < y, x = y and return (x, True).
    convenient when solving problems of dp[i]
    
    Args:
        x (long): current maximum value
        y (long): potential maximum value
    
    Returns:
        (x, bool): (x, True) when updated, else (x, False)
    """
    if x < y:
        x = y
        return (x, True)
    else:
        return (x, False)

def modinv(a, p = MOD):
    # evaluate reciprocal using Fermat's little theorem:

    return modpow(a, p-2, p)
def modinv_list(n, p = MOD):
    if n <= 1:
        return [0,1][:n+1]
    else:
        inv_t = [0,1]
        for i in range(2, n+1):
            inv_t += [inv_t[p % i] * (p - int(p / i)) % p]
        return inv_t
def modfactorial_list(n, p = MOD):
    if n == 0:
        return [1]
    else:
        l = [0] * (n+1)
        tmp = 1
        for i in range(1, n+1):
            tmp = tmp * i % p
            l[i] = tmp
        return l
def modcomb(n, k, fac_list = [], p = MOD):
    # fac_list = modfactorial_list(100)
    # print(modcomb(100, 5, modfactorial_list(100)))
    from math import factorial
    if n < 0 or k < 0 or n < k: return 0
    if n == 0 or k == 0: return 1
    if len(fac_list) <= n:
        a = factorial(n) % p
        b = factorial(k) % p
        c = factorial(n-k) % p
    else:
        a = fac_list[n]
        b = fac_list[k]
        c = fac_list[n-k]
    return (a * modpow(b, p-2, p) * modpow(c, p-2, p)) % p

def gcd(a, b):
    a, b = max(a, b), min(a, b)
    while a % b > 0: a, b = b, a % b
    return b
  
def solve():
    file = sys.stdin.readline
    N, X = map(int, file().split())
    aoki = [None] * N
    for i in range(N):
        b, l, u = map(int, file().split())
        aoki[i] = [u, (X - b) * (u - l), l, -b]
    aoki.sort()
    low = [0] * (N + 1)
    high = [0] * (N + 1)
    takahashi = [0] * (N + 1)
    for i in range(N):
        low[i+1] = low[i] + aoki[i][3] *  (-1) * aoki[i][2]
        high[i+1] = high[i] + aoki[i][0]  * (-1) * aoki[i][3]
        takahashi[i+1] = takahashi[i] + aoki[i][0] * X

    minhour = X * N
    tmult = 1
    for i in range(1, N+1):
        S = low[i] + high[N] - high[i]
        tpoint = takahashi[N] - takahashi[i]
        tmult = max(tmult, aoki[i-1][2])
        if tpoint >= S:
            over = min(X, (tpoint - S) // aoki[i-1][0])

        if tpoint < S:
            extra = 0
            if math.ceil((S -tpoint) / tmult) > X: break
            else: extra = math.ceil((S - tpoint) / tmult)
            minhour = min(minhour, X * (N - i) + extra)
    print(minhour)

    return 0

def solve_agc034c():
    from bisect import bisect_left
    from collections import namedtuple
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    # input = TestCaseReader()

    Test = namedtuple('Test', 'Aoki_score lower_bound upper_bound')
    Test.Merit = lambda self, Takahashi_score: \
        self.lower_bound * Takahashi_score if Takahashi_score <= self.Aoki_score \
            else self.upper_bound * Takahashi_score - (self.upper_bound - self.lower_bound) * self.Aoki_score

    N, X = map(int, input().split())
    tests = []
    for _ in range(N):
        row = map(int, input().split())
        tests.append(Test(*row))
    tests.sort(key=lambda test: test.Merit(Takahashi_score=X), reverse=True)
    # 勝つ科目は重要度upper_bound,負ける科目は重要度lower_bound

    need = sum(test.lower_bound * test.Aoki_score for test in tests)

    *acc, = accumulate(test.Merit(Takahashi_score=X) for test in tests)

    bi = bisect_left(acc, need)  # bi問目まで完答でneed以上を達成(bi:1-indexed)=bi問解けばよい
    if bi == 0:
        print(0)  # 追加した
        return

    ge_need = acc[bi]  # need以上を達成するのに要した点数
    lt_need = acc[bi - 1]  # need未満の最大値を達成するのに要した点数

    def generate_candidates():
        INF = 10 ** 20
        for i, p in enumerate(tests, start=1):
            # p: partially_solved_test
            if i < bi:
                rest = need - (ge_need - p.Merit(Takahashi_score=X))
            else:
                rest = need - lt_need

            if rest <= p.Merit(Takahashi_score=p.Aoki_score):
                # 科目p単体の所要点数はAoki君以下でよく,lower_boundで計算
                add_ = (rest + p.lower_bound - 1) // p.lower_bound
            else:
                # 科目p単体の所要点数はAoki君を超える必要があり,upper_boundで計算
                add_ = p.Aoki_score
                add_ += (rest - p.Merit(Takahashi_score=p.Aoki_score) + p.upper_bound - 1) // p.upper_bound

            if add_ > X:
                yield INF
            else:
                ret = X * (bi - 1) + add_
                yield ret

    gen = generate_candidates()
    res = min(gen)
    print(res)
    return

    solve_agc034c()

import sys

from itertools import accumulate
import heapq


def solve(N: int, X: int, b: "List[int]", l: "List[int]", u: "List[int]"):

    # i番目のテストで高橋くんがx点とったとき、A-Bに加える量
    def f(i, x):
        if x <= b[i]:
            return l[i]*(x-b[i])
        else:
            return u[i]*(x-b[i])

    # あらかじめ、0点とった時とX点とった時の効果が大きい順に並べておく
    mh = [[f(i, X)-f(i, 0), i] for i in range(N)]
    mh.sort(reverse=True)
    mX = [f(i, X) for _, i in mh]
    mXacc = list(accumulate(mX))
    m0 = [f(i, 0) for _, i in mh]
    m0acc = list(accumulate(m0))
    # print(mh)
    # print(mX)
    # print(mXacc)
    # print(m0)
    # print(m0acc)

    def isOK(index, key):
        # 勉強時間Tとしてスコア(A-B)を最大化するよう勉強時間を配分する
        T = index
        num = 1+T//X          # 点をとるテストの個数
        # print(num)
        # いったんX点とらせる
        # D = sum([f(i, X) for _, i in mh[:num]])\
        #     + sum([f(i, 0) for _, i in mh[num:]])
        # print(D)
        # print("A", mXacc[num-1])
        # print("B", m0acc[-1]-m0acc[num-1])
        D = mXacc[num-1] + m0acc[-1]-m0acc[num-1]
        # print(D)
        # 点を取るテストの中で、点数をT%X点に変更した時、
        # 最も減少の小さいものを選ぶ
        a = [0]*N
        for _, j in mh[:num]:
            a[j] = X
        if num != 0:
            v, i = min([[f(i, X)-f(i, T % X), i] for _, i in mh[:num]])
            D -= v
            a[i] = T % X
        # print(D)
        # print(a)
        return D >= key

    def binary_search(key):
        ng = -1
        ok = N*X
        while abs(ok - ng) > 1:
            mid = (ok + ng)//2
            # print("ng, mid, ok = {}, {}, {}".format(ng, mid, ok))
            if isOK(mid, key):
                ok = mid
            else:
                ng = mid
        return ok

    ans = binary_search(0)
    print(ans)
    return

def accumulate(a):
    """初項0"""
    su = 0
    yield su

    for x in a:
        su += x
        yield su


def solve_agc034c():
    from bisect import bisect_left
    from collections import namedtuple
    from functools import lru_cache
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.readline

    Test = namedtuple('Test', 'Aoki_score lower_bound upper_bound')

    Test.Merit = lambda self, Takahashi_score: \
        self.lower_bound * Takahashi_score if Takahashi_score <= self.Aoki_score \
            else self.upper_bound * Takahashi_score - (self.upper_bound - self.lower_bound) * self.Aoki_score
    Test.Merit = lru_cache(maxsize=None)(Test.Merit)

    N, X = map(int, input().split())
    tests = []
    for _ in range(N):
        row = map(int, input().split())
        tests.append(Test(*row))
    tests.sort(key=lambda test: test.Merit(Takahashi_score=X), reverse=True)
    # 勝つ科目は重要度upper_bound,負ける科目は重要度lower_bound

    need = sum(test.lower_bound * test.Aoki_score for test in tests)

    *acc, = accumulate(test.Merit(Takahashi_score=X) for test in tests)

    bi = bisect_left(acc, need)  # bi問目まで完答でneed以上を達成(bi:1-indexed)=bi問解けばよい
    ge_need = acc[bi]  # need以上を達成するのに要した点数
    lt_need = acc[bi - 1]  # need未満の最大値を達成するのに要した点数

    def generate_candidates():
        INF = 10 ** 20
        for i, p in enumerate(tests, start=1):
            # p: partially_solved_test
            if i < bi:
                rest = need - (ge_need - p.Merit(Takahashi_score=X))
            else:
                rest = need - lt_need

            if rest <= p.Merit(Takahashi_score=p.Aoki_score):
                # 科目p単体の所要点数はAoki君以下でよく,lower_boundで計算
                add_ = (rest + p.lower_bound - 1) // p.lower_bound
            else:
                # 科目p単体の所要点数はAoki君を超える必要があり,upper_boundで計算
                add_ = p.Aoki_score
                add_ += (rest - p.Merit(Takahashi_score=p.Aoki_score) + p.upper_bound - 1) // p.upper_bound

            if add_ > X:
                yield INF
            else:
                ret = X * (bi - 1) + add_
                yield ret

    gen = generate_candidates()
    res = min(gen)
    print(res)
    return

    solve_agc034c()

def combinations_count(n, r):
    # faster than the following code
    # def combinations_count(n, r):
    #     return factorial(n) // (factorial(n - r) * factorial(r))
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n
    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    for p in range(2,r+1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p-1,r,p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot
    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])
    return result
def combination_with_repetition_count(n, r):

def bisect_right_callable(fn, x, lo, hi):
    """
    lo から hi-1 のうち、fn の結果が x 以下となる、最も右の値 + 1
    bisect.bisect_right と同じ
    https://docs.python.org/ja/3/library/bisect.html
    :param callable fn:
    :param x:
    :param int lo: 最小値
    :param int hi: 最大値 + 1
    :return: lo <= ret <= hi
    """
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if x < fn(mid):
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid + 1
    return lo

def accumulate(a):
    su = 0
    yield su

    for x in a:
        su += x
        yield su

    Test.D_partial = lambda self, score: \
        self.lower_bound * score if score <= self.Aoki_score \
            else self.upper_bound * score - (self.upper_bound - self.lower_bound) * self.Aoki_score

    def is_ok(init_rest):
        """init_rest: 勉強に使える時間"""

            if d >= 0:

    def binary_search(*, ok, ng, is_ok):
        while abs(ok - ng) > 1:
            mid = (ok + ng) // 2
            if is_ok(mid):
